note: Set A captures two important facts that Set B omits entirely: the thruster firing period (every few 100 s) and the imaging EMCCD operating temperature (153 K). Set B also duplicates several claims (f/# 1330 twice, 1.9" twice, 11.9" twice) and misbinds one claim by attributing the spectroscopy field stop diameter to the 'visible channel' as the property. Both sets otherwise agree on the optical path, filter passbands, field stop sizes, IFS composition, and figure-label components, so A's coverage advantage is decisive.
